text:
[RARC.5.3.1] The runtime builds the network from the compiled rule set; the
network is the runtime's own, not a vendored engine. Its firing order is
deterministic ([LDET.5]) but not legible from source text alone, and the
introspection queries expose it ([NDBG.4]).

idris.name: Rarc_5_3_1__network
idris.note: The network: the alpha nodes and one chain per rule.
